description: S.G. Power Limited was incorporated in 1994 as a gas-based captive power plant whose sole consumer was its associated company, SG Allied Businesses Limited. In its own corporate briefing the company records that prolonged shortages of natural gas left it non-operational for several years, suspending generation, and that it is evaluating options to revive the business — a merger or strategic combination, a right issue, capital restructuring or new business lines — with any change of object clause and name to be announced once a strategy is selected. In May 2026 the board declared a 300% right issue of 53,499,600 ordinary shares at Rs 10 each.
headOffice: Second Floor, FNE House, 179 Abubakar Block, New Garden Town, Main Canal Road, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: The company's own PSX-filed Corporate Briefing Session 2025 presentation and the 18 May 2026 declaration of right shares, plus the PSX company profile record, read 2026-10-17.
